# Musette (ColorLib Accordion 13 Replication)

- **Source Template:** ColorLib Accordion 13 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-13/`)
- **Preview URL:** `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bac/accordion-13/`
- **Assigned App Name:** `musette` (`@free-react-templates/musette`)
- **Design Category:** Accordion / Interactive FAQ

## Section Structure & Fidelity Notes

1. **Header / Title Area:** Clean minimalist header introducing the accordion showcase.
2. **Accordion Showcase Section:**
   - Multiple collapsible item cards with clean borders (`#efefef`), rounded corners (4px), and soft padding.
   - Chevron indicators (down when closed, up when active).
   - Active state highlighting with accent color `#72c02c`.
3. **Footer:** Standard minimal footer with copyright and mandatory link to `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Design Tokens Extracted from CSS

- Background: `#fff`
- Paragraph Text: `#b3b3b3`
- Active Border & Accent: `#72c02c`
- Default Item Border: `#efefef`
- Font: Roboto
